notes.title: Merging Multiplayer between RealFlight 7, 8, and 9.
notes.notes:
Going all the way back to RealFlight G2, RealFlight's multiplayer feature has always been sequestered by major version. Users with G3 cannot join a G4 session, RF6 users cannot join a G5 session, etc.

If you have RealFlight 7 or later, that is no longer the case! We merged the RF7, RF8, & RF9 multiplayer worlds such that they can all see and join each other's sessions.

New public versions 8.00.056 and 9.00.022 are available for RF8 & RF9, respectively. You must download them to participate in multiplayer.

RF7 does not require an update; RF7 users will be involved automatically.

Older versions of RealFlight (RF6 and earlier) will continue to work as they always have.

Please enjoy!

notes.title: RealFlight 9 is coming soon!
notes.notes:
RealFlight 9 is coming soon on Steam! This new version adds even more great
aircraft from Horizon Hobby, as well as exciting new features. These include
new SAFE/STS technology, a brand new training system, and support for the
amazing new InterLink DX controller. Check it out on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1070820/RealFlight_9/]RealFlight 9 product page[/url].

Just bought RealFlight 8? No worries! Anyone who purchased RF8 on Steam
after 2PM Pacific time on July 15th, 2019 will automatically receive a copy
of RealFlight 9 shortly after it becomes available.

notes.title: The Horizon Hobby Edition is on Steam!
notes.notes:
The Horizon Hobby Edition of RealFlight 8 is what almost everyone has been asking and waiting for! It adds the exclusive technologies and some of the most popular aircraft from the best brands in RC to the #1 RC flight simulator in the world, to deliver an experience you simply can't find anywhere else. There are two ways you can get it:

[b]Already have RealFlight 8? Get the Add-On![/b]
All of the Horizon Hobby Edition aircraft are included in RealFlight 8’s first DLC pack: The Horizon Hobby Edition Add-On. This package will update your existing RF8 copy to the Horizon Hobby Edition, including 13 new aircraft and 2 new challenges.

[b]Buy the RealFlight 8 Horizon Hobby Edition[/b]
Once the Add-On is released, all new copies of RealFlight 8 will be the Horizon Hobby Edition. This package will include RealFlight 8 and the Horizon Hobby Edition Add-On. So if you’ve been waiting for RealFlight to include your favorite Horizon aircraft before you buy, your wait is almost up!

For more information on RF8 HHE, and the HHE Add-On, check out RealFlight.com. Both products will be released on Steam on October 29, 2018.

If you purchased your copy of RealFlight 8 after September 1st, 2018, you are eligible to get the Add-On DLC for free. We are still working on the mechanics of this, but will be working through it in the coming weeks.
